consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was solid, with notable highlights in the second set. While some reviews mention issues with the recording quality, many praise the overall energy and song selection of the show.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 28 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: The show had a good performance and setlist, but mixed reviews regarding the recording quality and some chaotic moments led to a moderate adjustment from a neutral baseline.
